empty.description: A newly provisioned disposable account with no user-created data.

small.description: Only the deterministic entities created by one journey; no shared seed account. The visual checkpoint cases import one fixed library instead, whose values are constants rather than namespaced, because a screenshot compared with yesterday's must show the same words.

scale.description: A generated library imported through Settings → Data into a fresh disposable account: seed/library.ts for a realistic library, web/fixtures/library.ts for a paged journey whose row order is known.

deterministic.description: Unresolvable links whose typed URL fallback is the assertion.

onlineExtraction.description: IANA's reserved documentation page. Not ours: no og:image, no redirect. A run-scoped ?e2e= query keeps each saved URL unique.
Any unknown path on the same origin answers a real 404, which settles as a permanent failure. A run-scoped suffix keeps each URL unique.
